value.rationale: A natural square-zero nilpotent stratum of the classical POE semigroup has two fundamental distinct size invariants. The result determines their complete joint feasible support and exact multiplicities, gives Catalan/Narayana marginals and sharp maximal image-rank multiplicities, with a conceptual reversible semigroup/tree correspondence.
